summary:
Implementation plan completed for K PERFORMANCE:
- Fixed the 'Mais' button in the navigation bar with click toggle, outside-click listener, Escape key handler, and touch-friendly mobile drawer integration.
- Expanded the Food Catalog to +100 popular bodybuilding foods organized into 7 categories + Favorites, with instant search, dietary tags, inline quick peek, and full comparative dossier modal (portion vs 100g, preparation, synergy tips, meal timing).
- Built interactive Workout Calendar featuring both Monthly Grid (month navigation, 'Hoje' return button, color-coded workout status) and Weekly timeline view, with a Day Inspector modal to schedule, edit, complete, or launch workouts directly.
- Enhanced Evolution Tracker with strength progression charts (estimated 1RM), body measurements history tracking with delta, and a private local progress photo gallery.
- Added a new interactive Nutrition & Food Catalog showcase section on HomeView.
- Verified zero build or lint issues via compile_applet and lint_applet.
